deployment: Local candidate only; not published by this audit
decision: Hold release; ten issue groups addressed, post-tracing viewport export remains an open acceptance blocker
remaining_observation: Viewport PNG export after path tracing timed out in both combined and fresh browser sessions on software graphics. Raster export before tracing passed. Post-tracing export remains unverified and requires investigation on supported Windows hardware.

issues.issue: PDF downloads could not be opened
issues.cause: The PDF writer emitted literal backslash-n characters instead of PDF line breaks.
issues.fix: Fixed PDF syntax and cross-reference offsets. Strict parsing and independent rendering pass.
issues.evidence: Automated regression; real browser download; pypdf and MuPDF.

issues.issue: Edits made during Team publishing could be missed
issues.cause: The client marked the current state as saved after an older snapshot finished uploading; title-only edits were not tracked.
issues.fix: Track the submitted revision separately, keep later edits pending, include title changes, and pin/abort connections when disconnecting.
issues.evidence: Two browser clients; delayed upload; automatic next revision; title-only receiving; feedback.

issues.issue: A failed 3D import could replace existing work
issues.cause: The current scene was cleared before saved texture images finished decoding.
issues.fix: Validate and decode the replacement first. A failed import preserves the scene and clears the file input for retry.
issues.evidence: Reproduced on the baseline; malformed texture import preserves both existing meshes in the candidate.

issues.issue: The app could create files outside its own reopen limits
issues.cause: 3D duplication bypassed the 200,000-triangle limit; scene saves lacked the 30 MB limit; brush totals could exceed the project validator’s 100-brush limit.
issues.fix: Enforce duplicate and scene-save limits, cap custom brushes across imports, and validate 2D frames before saving.
issues.evidence: Baseline reached 234,496 triangles; candidate boundary browser checks and brush/save regressions pass.

issues.issue: Duplicated texture paint lost editable layer state
issues.cause: Mesh duplication copied the material but did not clone its paint-layer canvases.
issues.fix: Clone the layer stack and canvases independently. Initialize the base-colour export canvas.
issues.evidence: UV unwrap; save original and copy; compare layer data; repaint copy without changing original.

issues.issue: GLB export could omit an existing rig animation
issues.cause: Animation export depended on the currently selected mesh being the rig.
issues.fix: Track the rig target separately and export its pose keys even when another mesh is selected.
issues.evidence: Exported GLB contains skins and animation with an unrigged cube selected.

issues.issue: Very short speedpaints could export an empty video
issues.cause: The browser encoder could finish before producing a frame for a very short clip.
issues.fix: Hold the final frame until at least 500 ms for short exports.
issues.evidence: Empty-video error reproduced; corrected one-stage WebM independently decoded with ffprobe.

issues.issue: Several export options were ignored or produced wrong backgrounds
issues.cause: Guides were missing at master size or misplaced in resized output; SVG ignored transparency; opaque formats did not consistently flatten empty pixels to white.
issues.fix: Draw guides before resizing, pass transparency through SVG, and composite white for JPG/TIFF/PSD/PDF.
issues.evidence: Pixel regressions, SVG embedded-image check, and independently opened PNG/JPG/TIFF/PSD/PDF files.

issues.issue: Image and project imports had incomplete failure handling
issues.cause: A delayed image could land after a new document was created; invalid images lacked a useful error; later-frame failure could retain the rejected title/onion state.
issues.fix: Bind image decoding to its starting document, show decode errors, release temporary URLs, and restore project metadata on failure.
issues.evidence: Real malformed PNG, delayed decode after New, artwork comparisons and rollback regression.

issues.issue: Privacy information was hard to reach from the app
issues.cause: The local launcher did not serve privacy.html and the page was not part of the offline cache.
issues.fix: Add app, AI and Team privacy links; serve and precache the existing bilingual page; advance the cache to v12.
issues.evidence: Local launcher response, new-tab privacy opening, RTL content and offline subfolder navigation.
